select * from ( select vfp.finprod_id as finprodId, /** 资产代码 **/ vfp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, /**资产名称**/ vfp.finprod_market_id as finprodMarketId, /**市场代码**/ type.type_1 as fundType, /** 资金类型 **/ vfp.profit_type as profitType,/** 收益类型 **/ vfp.ISSUER as issuer, /** 管理人 -发行人 **/ vfp.ccy as ccy, /** 币种 **/ vfp.idate as idate, /** 发行日 **/ vfp.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId, /** 交易日历 **/ msi.CALENDAR_NAME calendarName,/**交易日历名称**/ vfp.bln_area as blnArea, /** 境内外 **/ vfp.trade_market as tradeMarket, /** 交易场所 **/ vfp.ISSUER as custodian, /** 托管人 **/ ext.pur_speed as purSpeed, /** 申购确认速度 **/ ext.red_speed as redSpeed, /** 赎回确认速度 **/ vfp.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE as capiIncomeFeature, /** 本金收益特征 **/ rule.pay_cycle as payCycle, /** 分红频率 **/ rule.EFF_DATE as sdate, /** 分红日(生效日) **/
rule.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, /*截止日营业日准则*/ rule.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, /*支付日营业日准则*/ rule.CALC_RULE as calcRule, /** 推算方式 **/ ext.IS_COMPOUND_INT as isCompoundInt /**是否按日复利**/ from FIN_PRODUCT vfp /**标的类金融产品**/ left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE type /**金融产品分类表**/ on vfp.finprod_id = type.finprod_id left join fin_CASH_PAY_RULE rule /**现金流支付规则表**/ on vfp.finprod_id = rule.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ext /**标的类金融产品扩展表**/ on vfp.finprod_id = ext.finprod_id left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO msi on vfp.CALENDAR_ID = msi.CALENDAR_ID where vfp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY rule.Eff_Date desc ) WHERE rownum=1

select plan.vdate vdate,/**计息开始日**/ plan.mdate mdate,/**计息结束日**/ plan.pay_date pay_date/**付息日**/ from FIN_CASH_INFO cash inner join fin_CASH_PLAN plan on cash.cash_id = plan.cash_id where cash.cash_type_1 = '02' and cash.finprod_id = #{finprodId} order by plan.vdate ASC
SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId}
mapper.update: update FIN_PRODUCT set FINPROD_ABBR = #{finprodAbbr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINPROD_NAME = #{finprodName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PROFIT_TYPE = #{profitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BLN_AREA = #{blnArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IDATE = #{idate,jdbcType=DATE}, ISSUER = #{issuer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE = #{capiIncomeFeature,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

update FIN_CASH_INFO set CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL} where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

update FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE set CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EFF_DATE = #{effDate,jdbcType=DATE}, PAY_CYCLE = #{payCycle,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
END_TDAY_RULE = #{endTdayRule,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_TDAY_RULE = #{payTdayRule,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASH_UNIT_TYPE = #{cashUnitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_TYPE = #{payType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CALC_RULE = #{calcRule,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL} where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

update FIN_CASH_PLAN set CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASH_NUM = #{cashNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, VDATE = #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}, MDATE = #{mdate,jdbcType=DATE}, PAY_DATE = #{payDate,jdbcType=DATE}, CASH_UNIT_TYPE = #{cashUnitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL} where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
